lines.t: Wondering lost in the valley so wide Shadows grew tall where my hope would hide
But a voice like the wind, it called my name Through the storm, through the pain, it lit a flame
You lead my steps, my heart will follow Through every joy, through every sorrow
Yeah, who's true, my shepherd, my father, my guide
You hold my hand when the rivers run wide
You carry me through when the mountains are steep
Yeah, who's true, my shepherd, my soul safe to keep
Fields of green stretch where your mercy flows
Every sunrise your love it shows
You mend the cracks in my weary soul
You make me whole, you make me whole
When the night comes near you're my light, my shield
Every broken heart you gently heal
Your promise stands forever true
Yahushua my shepherd I run to you
Yahushua, my shepherd, my father, my guide
You hold my hand when the rivers run wide
You carry me through when the mountains are steep
Yahushua, my shepherd, my soul safe to keep
Yahushua, my shepherd
My father, my guide
You hold my hand when the rivers run wide
You carry me through when the mountains are steep
Yahushua, my shepherd, my soul safe to keep
My soul's safe to keep
Yahushua, my shepherd
My soul's safe to keep
Yahushua, my shepherd
